Thanks again for confirming the week-of Aug 23 for the 2-day Premier onboarding workshop in Boston. Per our internal planning the team has recommended a small travel policy exception to accommodate a couple of senior execs on AcroMed's side who have requested direct flights and flexible arrival windows. Summary of the ask: 

- 4 pax Redwood onsite leads (engineering & CS) + 2 AcroMed senior attendees (requested)
- Requested travel exception: 2x one-way premium economy / first-class upgrades for AcroMed execs to arrive the evening before (Aug 22) and depart late on Aug 25
- Additional hotel nights: 1 extra night for overlap (Aug 22) at the partner hotel
- Estimated incremental cost: see attached acromed_cost_breakdown.xlsx (~$9.4k incremental)

We want to be transparent: this pushes the onsite budget beyond our standard S&M travel cap for Premier accounts. If AcroMed will cover incremental guest upgrades we can keep Redwood spend to the baseline; otherwise we're requesting a one-time Redwood variance to cover up to $12k incremental to avoid rebooking. 

Can you confirm whether AcroMed will absorb the guest upgrades or if you'd like Redwood to cover and invoice after? I copied onsite ops for any logistical constraints. Also attaching the SecureTravel quote — they can lock fares with a 72-hr hold.

Attachments: acromed_cost_breakdown.xlsx, securetravel_quote_0714.pdf

Best,
